# Candidate B truth tables (generated by scripts/truth_table.py, candidate_b_tables)

DIS of the as-built chain, 1 = drive disabled, 0 = drive enabled (a masked fault), U = undetermined. One rail in the listed state, the monitor with the listed fault, other rails OK. Analog response from monitor_fault_sim.evaluate.

Supply states (by rule, not simulated):

- DEAD and LDO5_FAIL: DIS 1 (as the g05 table).
- P-N 2.0..2.7 V: LM339B inside its 2 V minimum (SLCS006Z p.6); TL431 not yet regulating, halfref ~0.45 P, span-UV tap P/13 < halfref -> span UV pulls low -> DIS 1.
- P-N ~1.7..2.0 V: LM339B below its 2 V minimum and TPS70950 below its 2.7 V minimum input (SBVS186H p.4); downstream (ISO6721FB side 1 >= 1.71 V, G132 >= 1.65 V, c24) may be live -> 'good' undetermined. **Sliver remains on paper**, narrower than c24's 2.3-3.0 V (c24 used a 3 V LM339B minimum; the data sheet says 2 V). Driver UVLO (8.5 V) holds the gates low there.

Supply states (by rule, not simulated):

- DEAD (P-N ~ 0): local 5 V and isolator side 1 dead -> default LOW / no wave -> DIS 1.
- P-N 0.8..1.8 V: TPS3701 in UVLO, OUTA driven low (SBVS240C p.5 note 2, p.11) -> DIS 1.
- P-N 1.8..17 V below the span-UV threshold: INA < 0.4 V -> OUTA low -> DIS 1.
- P-N < 0.8 V: outputs Hi-Z (p.11) but the local 5 V is below 0.8 V, so the isolator / oscillator downstream are unpowered -> DIS 1. **Sliver closed.**
